pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, King David Playing the Harp — the old king with his hands on the strings and his eyes lifted, of David, bless the LORD O my soul
pictures.name: pd_rubens_david

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Saint Augustine — the burning heart held up toward the light of Truth, all that is within me bless His holy name
pictures.name: pd_champaigne_binnenste

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Feast in the House of Simon the Pharisee — the woman at Christ's feet in the middle of the great table, bless the LORD O my soul and do not forget all His kind deeds
pictures.name: pd_veronese_vergeeft

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Miracles of Saint Francis Xavier — the sick brought out and raised up where the word is preached, He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases
pictures.name: pd_rubens_geneest

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Coronation of the Virgin — the crown lowered by the Father and the Son onto the head of the lowly, who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_kroont

pictures.scene: Domenichino, Saint John the Evangelist — the young saint with the great eagle beside him looking up into the light, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's
pictures.name: pd_domenichino_arend

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Bol, Moses Descends from Mount Sinai with the Ten Commandments — the tablets carried down in both arms out of the cloud, He made known His ways to Moses
pictures.name: pd_bol_mozes

pictures.scene: James Tissot, The Ark Passes Over the Jordan — the whole nation following the ark between the standing waters, His deeds to the people of Israel
pictures.name: pd_tissot_israel

pictures.scene: Guercino, The Woman Taken in Adultery — Christ turning quietly to the accuser with the woman spared beside Him, He will not always accuse us
pictures.name: pd_guercino_aanklagen

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Carrying the Cross — Christ holding the beam with both hands and looking up, He has not dealt with us according to our sins
pictures.name: pd_greco_zonden

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Cotopaxi — an enormous burning sky standing far above a low dark earth, for as high as the heavens are above the earth
pictures.name: pd_church_hemelen

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbarán, Crucifixion — Christ alone on the cross against the darkness with His arms stretched wide, as far as the east is from the west
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_oosten

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, The Holy Family with a Little Bird — Joseph seated with the child on his knee and his hand steadying him, as a father has compassion on his children
pictures.name: pd_murillo_vader

pictures.scene: Jusepe de Ribera, The Clubfoot — the crippled boy smiling with his crutch on his shoulder and his paper asking alms for the love of God, for He knows our frame
pictures.name: pd_ribera_maaksel

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Wheatfield with Crows — the wheat bending under a storm-blue sky with the crows going over, as for man his days are like grass
pictures.name: pd_gogh_stof

pictures.scene: Jan van Huysum, Vase of Flowers — crown imperial and poppy and roses open at their fullest for one morning, he blooms like a flower of the field
pictures.name: pd_huysum_bloem

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Winter Landscape with Church — the crutches thrown down in the snow and the man at the crucifix with the cathedral rising out of the mist, and its place remembers it no more but from everlasting to everlasting
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_plaats

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Supper at Emmaus — Christ's hand out over the bread in blessing at the table, the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_goedheid

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts, The Last Supper — Christ raising His hand over the bread with the twelve around the table, to those who keep His covenant
pictures.name: pd_bouts_verbond

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Holy Trinity — the Father holding the Son with the dove above them and the angels all around, the LORD has established His throne in heaven
pictures.name: pd_greco_troon

pictures.scene: Pietro Perugino, The Archangel Michael — the archangel standing in full armour with his sword and the scales hanging beside him, bless the LORD all His angels mighty in strength
pictures.name: pd_perugino_engelen

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Defeat of Sennacherib — the angels coming down out of the light on the army in the night and the horses going over, who carry out His word
pictures.name: pd_rubens_woord

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, the Ghent Altarpiece: The Adoration of the Mystic Lamb — the Lamb on the altar with rank on rank of angels and saints kneeling in the meadow, bless the LORD all His hosts
pictures.name: pd_eyck_heirscharen

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, View of Haarlem with Bleaching Grounds — a whole country of fields and cottages and one church tower under an immense sky, bless the LORD all His works in all places of His dominion
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_werken

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, Simeon's Song of Praise — the old man holding the child in the one shaft of light in the temple and singing, bless the LORD O my soul
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_ziel

lines.text: Of David.
Bless the LORD, O my soul;
all that is within me, bless His holy name.
Bless the LORD, O my soul,
and do not forget all His kind deeds—
He who forgives all your iniquities
and heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from the Pit
and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
who satisfies you with good things,
so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
The LORD executes righteousness
and justice for all the oppressed.
He made known His ways to Moses,
His deeds to the people of Israel.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious,
slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
He will not always accuse us,
nor harbor His anger forever.
He has not dealt with us according to our sins
or repaid us according to our iniquities.
For as high as the heavens are above the earth,
so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
As far as the east is from the west,
so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
As a father has compassion on his children,
so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
For He knows our frame;
He is mindful that we are dust.
As for man, his days are like grass—
he blooms like a flower of the field;
when the wind passes over, it vanishes,
and its place remembers it no more.
But from everlasting to everlasting
the loving devotion of the LORD
extends to those who fear Him,
and His righteousness to their children’s children—
to those who keep His covenant
and remember to obey His precepts.
The LORD has established His throne in heaven,
and His kingdom rules over all.
Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength
who carry out His word,
who hearken to the voice of His command.
Bless the LORD, all His hosts,
you servants who do His will.
Bless the LORD, all His works
in all places of His dominion.
Bless the LORD, O my soul!
